title: Artinian lifting and Rim--Schlessinger data for scheme families over an affine base
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and let $\mathcal X$ be a category fibred in groupoids over $S$-schemes [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids] [def-pc-scheme], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Define the following Artinian lifting data for a family. A local Artinian ring is a commutative ring with a unique maximal ideal and descending chain condition on ideals. The property $\operatorname{RS}_R(\mathcal X)$ says that for every pushout of spectra of local Artinian rings $D=B\amalg_A C$, all of finite type over $R$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], with $A\to C$ a closed immersion defined by a nilpotent ideal, the canonical restriction functor $\mathcal X(D)\to\mathcal X(B)\times_{\mathcal X(A)}\mathcal X(C)$ is an equivalence. Equivalently in the total category, every span of objects and arrows over $A\to B$, $A\to C$ has a pushout over $D$ whose arrows lie over the two cocone maps; the shared object over $A$ retains the specified overlap isomorphism. For an $S$-scheme $U$, an object $x\in\mathcal X(U)$, a field $K$ [def-weil-field], and $\alpha:\operatorname{Spec}K\to U$, define $\operatorname{Lift}_x(\alpha)$ by: for every surjection $q:B'\twoheadrightarrow B$ of local Artinian $R$-algebras, every surjective residue map $r:B\twoheadrightarrow K$ (with $rq$ the specified residue map of $B'$), every $R$-map $a:\operatorname{Spec}B\to U$ satisfying $a\operatorname{Spec}(r)=\alpha$, every $z\in\mathcal X(B')$, and every specified isomorphism $z|_B\cong a^*x$, there exist an $R$-map $a':\operatorname{Spec}B'\to U$ extending $a$ and an isomorphism $z\cong(a')^*x$ restricting to that exact isomorphism. Finally $x$ is versal at $p\in U$ if $\operatorname{Lift}_x(u_p)$ for the canonical $u_p:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(p)\to U$ [def-weil-residue-field]. Finite type of $p$ is imposed separately in uses of versality.
